  Self-taught tinkerer from France 🇫🇷. I run a personal VPS that hosts my own AI agent,

```text
$ whoami
Bounty13 — homelab tinkerer, Python enjoyer, Linux sysadmin

$ cat ~/.plan
- keep the self-hosted agent stack running (and understandable)
- automate the boring stuff, document the rest
- break things in staging, not in prod (mostly)
```

### 🔧 What I tinker with

- **Self-hosted AI agents**: running and extending [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) on my own box: plugins, memory, voice, cron jobs, multi-device access
- **Linux & VPS admin**: hardening, monitoring, backups, disk diets, and the occasional "why is this service eating 4 GB of RAM"
- **Desktop ricing**: Arch-based [Omarchy](https://omarchy.org) + Hyprland, dotfiles auto-backed-up
- **Small glue tools**: iOS Scriptable widgets for server stats, Discord Rich Presence clients, a few web mirrors
- **Knowledge base**: everything ends up in Obsidian, with decision records, because future me forgets
